videos.title: Welcome to Tea Break with Manoj ☕ Funny True History #shorts
videos.description:
Hello friends, I'm Manoj. Funny true stories from history, told in the time it takes to drink a cup of tea. Every story is real, and the sources are always in the description.

A new story every Saturday, and Shorts on Monday and Wednesday. Grab your tea and subscribe.

The voice is an AI copy of my own voice; the pictures are made with an AI image model, and the music is original.
